bartlett.lede: I'm Austin, and Bartlett is home. I've lived here for over 15 years, and I build fast, mobile-friendly websites that help Bartlett shops, salons, groomers and contractors get found on Google and get the call.

I'm in Bartlett, so a coffee or a visit to your shop is easy to set up.
Free draft first
You see a working draft of your site before you pay anything.

faqs: Can we meet in person?
Yes. I'm based in Bartlett, so meeting at your shop or over coffee is easy. Plenty of owners prefer to just call or text, and that works too.
Do you only work with Bartlett businesses?
No. I also work with businesses in Memphis, Cordova, Germantown, Arlington and Lakeland. Bartlett is just home base.
How fast will I hear back?
Within one business day. Call or text (901) 321-0023 and you reach me directly, not a call center.

A one-page Starter site is $350 and the Business site is $950, both one-time. Hosting is free, and the domain is about $10 to $12 a year.
